It is the tale of sun and time,  
the spruce retains some green, the pine a rhyme,  
while mountain aspens trade their blue for gold,  
hauling the woods in slow adoration,  
each drifting burnished veil a final salute to summer’s pause,  
yet love still haunts the cleanse of shed leaves,  
and snow will come to mend all wounds,  
until the bird bush keels under frost,  
queries whether dawn divides its갖.
